text: The Shivraj Fine Art Litho Works (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertaking) Act, 1984 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 198436 Act Number: 36 Enactment Date: 1984-12-21 Act Year: 1984 Short Title: The Shivraj Fine Art Litho Works (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertaking) Act, 1984 Long Title: An Act to provide for the acquisition and transfer of the undertaking of the Shivraj Fine Art Litho Works, Nagpur, with a view to securing the proper management of such undertaking so as to subserve the interests of the general public and the employees of the undertaking by ensuring the continued manufacture, production and distribution of printed lithographic material which are essential to the needs of the economy of the State and country and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
